blocking_visual_defects.defect: Scene wipes cut through Arabic headings, producing visibly truncated words during handoffs instead of protecting the reading layer.
blocking_visual_defects.evidence: handoff-contact.jpg: s1 at 2.08s and s3 at 10.80s show sliced outgoing headings. index.html handoff() clips the entire next scene, including its heading, while covering the outgoing heading.
blocking_visual_defects.fix: End the outgoing heading with a brief opacity exit before the wipe reaches it; reveal the new heading after the wipe clears its bounds. Alternatively keep headings outside the clipped visual stage.
blocking_visual_defects.acceptance: Check the encoded frames across every handoff: each visible heading is complete, correctly shaped and unoccluded, or fully absent. Keep the existing separate caption layer protected.

polish_notes.note: The ivory figure nearly disappears against the light product scene and reads much thinner than the opening figure.
polish_notes.evidence: scene-contact.jpg s2 at 8.65s and handoff-contact.jpg s2 at 6.84–7.08s.
polish_notes.suggestion: Strengthen its warm contour or add a restrained darker grounding shape, preserving a white/ivory body and the blank face.

positive_observations: The palette, original cover and restrained graphic hierarchy are coherent; the product is visible at 6.5s.
Menus have clear grouping, app scenes show concrete actions, and the closing price/CTA composition is quiet and legible in the supplied sheet.
limitations: Contact sheets establish sampled appearance only; no continuous motion or final encoded video has been reviewed.
No audio naturalness assessment or final approval is made.
